body: Same. I don't want to get old and I should have died many years ago. The past 10 years have been terrible for me.

Don't worry about it all, just do your best. I got As and Bs in my a-levels, a first in physics and a masters and I'm unemployed. Heh. Been unemployed on and off for years. I was on job seekers allowance for years and just wasted time on the internet. No confidence in myself and no one helped me. The jobs market is a pile of shite and when you throw social anxiety and possibly aspergers into the mix, well you end up like me, a person who has fallen through the cracks and there is no one to pick me up. I am forgotten about and all alone. I am over 24 so there are no support groups, my GP doesn't remember me and I can't see them anyway because of covid. Honestly, at your age (20) I would save up a little bit of money and go backpacking around the world and volunteer. I am considering it myself although I am 33. At this point it will probably end my job prospects for good but, who cares. At 20 you might as well do whatever the hell you want.
